Synopsis:
Lia has been rescued from Moonrise Towers by the player and is now in Last Light. This dialogue covers multiple states: Rolan is missing, Rolan is dead, Rolan and Lia had a fight (player must pass a persuade to calm the fight, pass and fail states here), and a general state for when cal, lia and rolan are all alive and well and Lia is grateful to the player.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_ProdigyLament_Sister.json: Lia is a tiefling rescued from Moonrise Towers and brought to Last Light; she and her siblings Cal and Rolan were swept up in the Absolute cultists’ raid, so she’s still raw from captivity and fearing for her family. Off‑screen events at Moonrise (zealous guards, mind‑melds, and a fraught jailbreak) determine whether Rolan is missing, dead, or merely estranged after a fight—some background notes even suggest Rolan may have helped others survive the initial capture. The conversation branches accordingly: some scenes have Lia quietly grieving and declaring “Rolan is dead,” others show an active fight between Lia and Rolan that the player can calm with a successful Persuade (or fail to calm). Lia’s tone toward the player—bitter, sarcastic, or grateful—depends on prior choices, who survived, and how the rescue was conducted.
- HAV_ProdigyLament_Brother.json: Cal is a tiefling the player recently pulled out of Moonrise Towers and is now recovering in Last Light; the tower raid by Absolute cultists and their guards is the off‑screen cause of his trauma. The dialogue can take one of several emotional states: Rolan may be missing, confirmed dead, or alive but estranged after a bitter fight with Cal. In the fight branch the player can attempt a Persuade to calm them — success soothes tensions, failure leaves anger and accusations unresolved. In the more hopeful branch Cal (with Lia and Rolan) is alive and grateful to the player for rescuing them.
- HAV_ProdigyLament_Reunion.json: Cal and/or Lia have been rescued from Moonrise towers and reunited with Rolan in Last Light Inn. It is initially a tense scene - Rolan was worried sick/is angry one of his siblings is dead and is taking it out on his family. It is up to the player to calm them down and remind them of what is important - family.
- HAV_ProdigyLament_AD_BeforeReunion.json: This AD covers the following scenarios: Lia alive, Cal dead. Cal alive, Lia dead. Cal, Lia and Rolan all alive and well. This AD occurs after the player has rescued Cal and/ or Lia from Moonrise towers, but BEFORE the player triggers the reunion scene in Last Light. The siblings are standing together and arguing.
- MOO_Jailbreak_ProdigySister.json: Lia and her brother Cal have been taken prisoner in Moonrise Towers; Lia is brave and used to danger but terrified for herself and Cal (and uncertain whether their other brother, Rolan, is alive), and she hides that fear behind anger and hostile quips. This scene is usually Lia behind bars talking to the player on the other side (with dialogue variants if the player was also arrested and ends up in the neighboring cell). Off‑screen a zealous, sadistic half‑orc Absolute jailer patrols the cells, can telepathically check for tadpoles and control who comes and goes, and the tower is on high alert after recent Execution/Audience events—any trouble may be reported or met with force. Cal is elsewhere restrained but desperate to help, and Lia may initially assume the player is a cult sympathizer (or a grove ally), so her suspicion can soften only if the player convincingly offers aid.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Lia: Now that I'm here, that I'm safe, it's finally sinking in. || [context] NodeContext: voice distant, barely processing the news (node 16)
- Lia: Rolan is dead. || [context] NodeContext: fists curling, quietly angry in her grief (node 2)
- Player: He died as he lived - stupidly. (node 29)

Sample 2:
- Lia: I know. He's dead. || [context] NodeContext: voice distant, barely processing the news (node 32)
- Lia: Rolan is dead. || [context] NodeContext: fists curling, quietly angry in her grief (node 2)
- Player: He died as he lived - stupidly. (node 29)

context: Lia is a tiefling the player rescued from Moonrise Towers and brought to the Last Light Inn; she and her siblings Cal and Rolan were swept up in the Absolute cultists’ raid, so she’s raw from captivity and terrified for her family. Off‑screen events at Moonrise (zealous guards, mind‑melds, and a fraught jailbreak) determine whether Rolan is missing, confirmed dead, or alive but estranged after a bitter fight—some branches present Lia quietly grieving and declaring “Rolan is dead.” Other variants stage an active confrontation between siblings in Last Light that the player can try to calm with a Persuade check; success soothes tensions, failure leaves anger and accusations unresolved. The player’s tone and choices (blunt, sarcastic, or compassionate) influence Lia’s responses, shifting her from bitter or defensive to grateful when the rescue and reunion go well.
